meta.name: env-and-assets-bootstrap
meta.description: Rigor Setup skill for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use when the task is specifically to prepare a conservative conda-first environment, checkpoint and dataset path assumptions, cache location hints, and setup notes before any run on a README-documented repository. Do not use for repo scanning, full orchestration, paper interpretation, final run reporting, or generic environment setup that is not tied to a specific reproduction target.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跑他人深度学习代码前,先备好环境和资源路径
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在复现深度学习项目,需要先按规范准备运行环境
copy.tagline_en: Prepare the environment and data paths before running a deep-learning project.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up the environment for a deep-learning repo before running it.

howto.what: 装上后,在复现某个带 README 的深度学习仓库前,Claude 会先制定保守的环境方案:给出候选 conda 命令、资源路径规划、checkpoint 与数据集来源提示,并列出未解决的风险。
howto.when: 当用户确认了复现目标、需要准备环境或资源路径,或仓库依赖 checkpoint、数据集、缓存目录时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个仓库准备 conda 环境和资源路径,先别跑命令。
say.note: 会产出环境与路径规划。

say.text: 规划 checkpoint 和数据集下载位置,并检查缺失风险。
say.note: 会给出资源路径和风险提示。

say.text: 用 conda 创建保守环境,并提示缓存目录。
say.note: 生成候选 conda 命令和缓存提示。

howto.what_en: After installation, before reproducing a deep learning repo with a README, Claude prepares a conservative environment plan: candidate conda commands, asset path planning, checkpoint/dataset source hints, and lists unresolved risks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user confirms a reproduction target and environment or asset path preparation is needed, or when the repo depends on checkpoints, datasets, or cache directories.

say_en.text: Prepare conda environment and asset paths for this repo, but don't run commands yet.
Plan checkpoint and dataset download locations, and check for missing risks.
say_en.note: Gives asset paths and risk hints.

say_en.text: Create a conservative conda environment and hint at cache directories.
say_en.note: Generates candidate conda commands and cache tips.
